content.title: Rory McIlroy Gives Update on Rumored Divorce With Wife Erica Stoll
content.text: Mar 15, 2025 11:00 AM EDT Rory McIlroy and wife Erica Stoll have had a challenging time as news broke of the couple filing for divorce ahead of the 2024 PGA Championship. Back in June, things took another turn when McIlroy revealed that the couple had reconciled and scrapped the divorce. McIlroy is one of the PGA Tour golfers featured on season three of the Netflix show “Full Swing,” which debuted on Feb. 25. The star golfer provided some candid insight into the thoughts about a divorce and where things stand now. “There’s parts of my life I like to keep as private as possible,” McIlroy said on the series, per The Mirror. “Unfortunately, in this line of work, that isn’t always possible. I have always been protective of my loved ones from people who have ill intentions. PGA golfer Rory McIlroy and his wife Erica Stoll watch game two of the 2019 NBA Finals.Kyle Terada-Imagn “Thankfully, everything has worked out for the best and we’re happy and moving forward and can’t wait for what lies ahead.” ESPN’s Mark Schlabach reported on June 11, 2024, that a motion was filed to “voluntarily dismiss” the divorce petition. “There have been rumors about my personal life recently, which is unfortunate,” McIlroy said in a statement at the time, per ESPN. “Responding to each rumor is a fool’s game. “Over the past weeks, Erica and I have realized that our best future was as a family together. Thankfully, we have resolved our differences and look forward to a new beginning.” Back in November, McIlroy posted a photo to Instagram of his wife cheering him on at a golf tournament. All indications are McIlroy and Stoll have smoothed things over despite the very public spotlight on the couple’s relationship.
